description: Creates a workspace grading session for finished student work, including paper, Google Docs or an AP Classroom export. Accepts a Fiveable FRQ or SAQ id, or the teacher's own question in prompt. A session uses an included assignment when grading starts unless the account has unlimited assignments. Returns the new session id.

fiveableQuestionId.description: frq:… or saq:… from search_question_bank, or frq: plus the FRQ id from get_frq.

prompt.description: The teacher's own question, when not a Fiveable one.

frqType.description: Question type as Fiveable names it, e.g. "Long Essay Question (LEQ)". Omit to get the list.

text.description: The question exactly as the teacher assigned it.

requestId.description: A unique id you generate for this action. Reuse it only when retrying the same action.

name: create_grading_session

status.description: Operation status: completed, pending, partial, failed, unavailable, or a domain-specific outcome.

text.description: Readable tool result text for clients that consume structured output.

title: Create grading session
